headline: TrendForce: Q4 DRAM contracts up 10-15%, NAND up 15-20%
quote: expects conventional DRAM contract prices to rise 10% to 15% in the fourth quarter from the third
claim: TrendForce expects conventional DRAM contract prices to rise 10% to 15% in the fourth quarter from the third, and NAND flash contract prices 15% to 20%, while spot trading stalls.
why_it_matters: RAM and SSD upgrades for the Inspiron's empty slot will stay expensive; waiting is unlikely to be cheaper soon.
title: DRAM Prices: TrendForce Sees 10-15% Q4 Rise as Spot Trade Stalls | Capital Times

headline: DDR4 spot price dips 0.09% to US$46.82; NAND wafer spot down 4.33%
quote: mainstream DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s spot prices dipped 0.09% amid shrinking trading volumes
claim: TrendForce's spot update says DDR4 1Gx8 3200MT/s fell 0.09% to US$46.82 on November 3 from US$46.86 a week earlier, and 512Gb TLC wafer spot prices fell 4.33% to US$16.152 as of November 2.
why_it_matters: Spot softness hasn't reached retail yet, but it shows buyers are resisting further hikes.
title: [Insights] Memory Spot Price Update: Mainstream DDR4 Prices Dip 0.09% as Spot Premium Keeps Buyers on Sidelines

headline: TrendForce: reballed DRAM in phones to reach 7-9% in 2027
quote: the penetration rate of reballed memory in the smartphone market will reach approximately 3–4% in 2026, potentially climbing to 7–9% in 2027
claim: TrendForce says persistently high mobile DRAM contract prices are pushing phone brands to reballed memory, and expects DRAM price increases to gain further momentum in 1Q27.
why_it_matters: Memory costs are pushing budget phone makers to cheaper parts; expect spec cuts or higher prices in entry devices.
title: Persistently High DRAM Prices Drive Adoption of Reballed Memory, with Smartphone Penetration Expected to Reach 7–9% in 2027, Says TrendForce

headline: ASUS ProArt P14 and P16 with RTX Spark launch in India from Rs 3,29,990
quote: The ProArt P14 with 24GB memory and a 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD is priced at Rs 3,29,990.
claim: ASUS launched the ProArt P14 (24GB, 1TB) at Rs 3,29,990, and the P16 at Rs 4,99,990 (64GB) and Rs 6,49,990 (128GB), with RTX Spark N1X and up to 128GB unified memory.
why_it_matters: First RTX Spark laptops in India sit well above the Rs 2.5 lakh budget, though they show unified-memory machines for local AI.
title: ASUS ProArt P16 and P14 Laptops Launched in India With NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X; Prices Start at Rs 3,29,990youtube [#16]
